description: This file implements a GzipSourceStream class for handling gzip and deflate compressed data streams, including header detection, decompression, and error handling.

classes.name: GzipSourceStream
classes.description: A class for decompressing gzip and deflate streams, handling headers, footers, and stream errors.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create and initialize a GzipSourceStream instance.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the zlib stream for decompression based on the stream type.

methods.name: GetTypeAsString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the stream type (GZIP or DEFLATE).

methods.name: FilterData
methods.description: Processes input data, decompresses it, and writes to output buffer, handling headers, footers, and errors.

methods.name: InsertZlibHeader
methods.description: Attempts to insert a dummy zlib header to recover from missing headers in deflate streams.
